enemies.name: King Bombadier
enemies.signature: Alternates two Memory Holes + two bombs with two Anger spaces + two bombs. The first wave is telegraphed at battle start. Bombs explode for 20 Fire on his next turn: one player turn to respond. Covering sacrifices the top card instead. From the third full cycle, both waves cast three bombs instead of two; the preceding warning shows all three. Machine Elves defuse immediately. Royal bombardment deals 18 Fire; Excavation deals 20 Arcane; Light the fuses deals 20 Fire. Deconstructed Steam hits for 12 Fire, then 15 Water, then 18 Wind. Direct hits gain +2 per full cycle, +1 per Restless level, and +3 at half HP. Once below 25% HP, Last Ditch Effort inserts one extra turn, pausing the normal cycle: resolves existing warnings and telegraphs six additional mines, without a direct attack. The next move resumes the cycle and places them; each mine still gives one full player turn to cover or defuse before its 20 Fire explosion. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Defuse or cover the bombs; prepare different elements for each Steam hit. Memory Holes take two turns to Mend, one when upgraded.
